mapper.select: SELECT trade_id, order_id, plan_id, ts_code, stock_name, board_code, role, side, price, qty, amount, trade_time, strategy_id, stage_at_entry, capital_confirm, entry_reason, exit_reason, planned_action, pnl, d1_ret, d5_ret, is_trap FROM sim_trade FINAL WHERE toDate(trade_time) = #{tradeDate} ORDER BY ts_code ASC, trade_time ASC

SELECT trade_id, order_id, plan_id, ts_code, stock_name, board_code, role, side, price, qty, amount, trade_time, strategy_id, stage_at_entry, capital_confirm, entry_reason, exit_reason, planned_action, pnl, d1_ret, d5_ret, is_trap FROM sim_trade FINAL WHERE ts_code = #{tsCode} ORDER BY trade_time ASC

SELECT trade_id, order_id, plan_id, ts_code, stock_name, board_code, role, side, price, qty, amount, trade_time, strategy_id, stage_at_entry, capital_confirm, entry_reason, exit_reason, planned_action, pnl, d1_ret, d5_ret, is_trap FROM sim_trade FINAL WHERE d1_ret IS NULL ORDER BY ts_code ASC, trade_time ASC
